crossRefs.note: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

translations.web: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.
translations.bsb: He never returns to his house; his place remembers him no more.
